title: Reviewed response projections for the existing synthetic API

ResponseFixedPlan.$comment: New preparations require context refs; legacy closed plans remain readable without invented context.

timeZone.$comment: The server additionally validates this value with java.time.ZoneId.of.

ResponseHandover.$comment: The package hash covers canonical JSON of the package projection. The server also enforces arithmetic totals, reference integrity, identity uniqueness and ordering, and time-range ordering; JSON Schema does not substitute for those checks.
